notes:
Short: Silverpine builds an internal RAG platform used by legal teams to surface precedent and policy. Wants a production-grade vector stack + reranker. Priorities: predictable latency, low cost per query, easy connector for incremental updates. Client currently eval'd Pinecone + open-source pgvector; running into scale pain at 10M+ docs.

Key quotes: "We need median p95 latency <100ms for topK retrieval and total end-to-end <250ms with reranker" — CTO.

Embedding strategy: client will provide precomputed 1536-d vectors for historical docs; wants option to generate embeddings on-the-fly for ingested content. Reranker: cross-encoder CPU-bound, expecting to run on dedicated CPU pool for re-ranking top50 -> top5. Concern: reranker adds cost per q — wants pricing scenarios for batched cross-encoder vs sparse re-rank.

Indexing: target index size 10M-50M vectors, frequent daily upserts (10k/day), low-latency incremental availability required (<30s). Also need metadata filtering (tenant_id, doc_type), multi-field hybrid scoring (BM25 + vector).

Operational: require monitoring for QPS, tokenization errors, rollout safety (canary model switch), and clear fallback to cheaper model variant when capacity constrained.

Ask from Redwood: connector spec (supported vector formats, upsert semantics, batch vs streaming), benchmarks for 10M index (latency @ 100QPS), cost per query scenarios (with/without cross-encoder), security package (SOC2 attestation, KMS config, data residency), and a short POC plan (30-day: ingest 10M sample, run 1k QPS synthetic, verify p95 end-to-end).
requirements_summary: Scale: 10M-50M vectors; Throughput: target 100-500 QPS in steady state; Latency SLOs: retrieval p95 <100ms, end-to-end p95 <250ms with reranking; Cost target: <$0.005 per query (retrieval only) and clear pricing for reranker; Features: incremental upserts (<30s visibility), metadata filters, hybrid BM25+vector, multi-tenant metadata isolation; Connector: bulk import + streaming upserts, schema mapping, backfill support, resume/retry, provenance metadata; Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2, KMS integration, EU data residency + audit logs.

ability to run hybrid queries (BM25 + vector) and return explainability scores
